_comment: Normative constants for the RoboTensor one-demonstration in-context imitation learning competition. Version 4 was published and then rolled back; that number is retired and never reused. Version 5 splits the competition into fields: each has its own demonstration modality, skills, pool, baseline, king, queue and lineage. Bumping spec_version changes every derived duel id.

sensorimotor.title: Sensorimotor demonstration
sensorimotor.blurb: The model is shown one demonstration - the frames, the action trajectory and the proprioception - and must do the task from a different initial state.
sensorimotor._comment: Renamed from the v3 track id 'icil_1demo'; the id is inside every signed record, so the store is rebuilt at v5. The replay shortcut is closed here by scoring from a different initial state than the demonstration started from (prompt_instance_disjoint).

_benchmarks_comment: Which distribution provides each simulator a skill names. An in-repo one needs no pin; one from another repository is found through the 'icilval.benchmarks' entry point group and is pinned by distribution, version and wheel sha256, because entry-point discovery imports code into the validator.

pick_and_place.title: Pick and place
pick_and_place.blurb: Grasp one object and place it at a destination: BPP's LIBERO-Gen Combination domain. Every task moves the black bowl from one pick location to one placement in the LIBERO-Spatial scene; the pool holds every combination BPP generated demonstrations for, and a unit starts from one of the task's initial states with another episode of the same task as the demonstration.

tasks._comment: Every task in these views of BPP's LIBERO-Gen Combination release: bddl_files/<view>/<task>.bddl, init_files/<view>/<task>.pruned_init, demonstration_data/<view>/<task>_demo.hdf5. The pool holds demos_per_task demonstrations of each and treats the views alike.

goal_chain.title: Goal chain
goal_chain.blurb: Do two things in order - open a drawer, turn on the stove or push a plate, then place an object - as BPP's LIBERO-Gen Chain domain defines it. The pool holds every two-step chain BPP generated demonstrations for; a unit starts from one of the task's initial states with another episode of the same task as the demonstration, and succeeds when both goals hold.

tasks._comment: The two chain views of BPP's LIBERO-Gen Chain release; the first-step and second-step views are single steps, not chains, and stay out.

draw_anything.title: Draw anything
draw_anything.blurb: Reproduce a drawing shown once. The demonstration is a human drawing the shape on a square whiteboard; the model draws it again on a board turned to a random angle, with the pen starting at a random place, as BPP's DrawAnything-Sim domain evaluates it.

tasks._comment: BPP's DrawAnything-Sim replay buffers, one pool group per file: the human-drawn evaluation set (50 drawings, 5 demonstrations each) and the procedural training set (2000 drawings, 10 each), treated alike.

environment._comment: DrawAnything-Sim as BPP evaluates it: a 512 px canvas with a 350 px square board, 10 Hz position control of a pen (x, y, pen_down), one 224 px observation, prompts chunked every 10 actions with the trailing partial chunk dropped. A unit's board angle is uniform in board_angle_range_rad and its pen start uniform in cursor_start_range_px, the ranges DrawEnv samples from; both are derived from the task id and instance index. An episode also ends when the pen has not moved idle_stop_px for idle_stop_steps steps, as in BPP's runner.

success._comment: A unit succeeds iff the lowest symmetric Chamfer distance, in canvas pixels, between the demonstrated strokes and the drawn strokes at any step of the episode is at most threshold (the pen is 12 px wide). Calibrated on 80 units drawn from pool 2026.09-v2 with the genesis checkpoint: best-Chamfer percentiles 10/25/50/75/90 = 0.96/1.39/2.46/3.83/7.21 px; the baseline succeeds on 0.79 of the units at 4 px, its misses being the long multi-part drawings. See docs/pools.md.

pools._comment: pool_id is filled by `icilval pools build` and must equal pool.json's id; the validator refuses to run on a mismatch. demos_per_task is how many of a task's demonstrations the pool keeps; init_states_per_task also sizes the drawing skill's table of (board angle, cursor start) instances.

duel._crown_comment: Both sides run the identical unit list (same tasks, initial states, prompt demonstrations and seeds). Per-skill success rate is stored as a fraction in [0, 1]; the final score is the mean over skills. A skill's units are spread evenly over its eligible tasks. The challenger takes the crown iff challenger.average >= king.average + score_margin / 100. Paired per-unit outcomes are published as a diagnostic and never decide the crown.
duel._max_steps_comment: skills.<skill>.max_steps are per-skill caps; each task carries its own (smaller) limit from its source benchmark.
duel._default_comment: Defaults. A track may override sizes, score_margin or max_void_fraction; an override must declare the same size names, so a submitter sees one vocabulary.

model._comment: A submission is a Hugging Face model repo holding one directory per skill, each with model.safetensors and config.yaml. For every skill the validator instantiates the architecture from its own allow-listed template (arch/<architecture>.cfg.json), diffs the submitted config against it, checks the safetensors header against arch/<architecture>.tensors.json, and loads weights strictly. No pickle is ever read and no entrant code runs. max_params applies per skill; max_repo_bytes to the whole repo.
model._mutable_comment: Dotted paths under `model` that may differ from the template without affecting inference. Training-only keys are overwritten by the converter, so they never differ.

media._comment: resolution and camera describe LIBERO clips; draw clips are the board render at skills.draw_anything.environment.render_resolution and draw demonstration clips are the 224 px observation frames.

store._layout_comment: manifest.json; tracks/{track}/{head.json,queue.json,index-NNNN.jsonl}; events/{track}/{event_id}.json; media/{sha[:2]}/{sha}.mp4. Index lines are '<canonical_json>\t<ed25519_signature_hex>', append-only.

sensorimotor.label: BPP public checkpoints, converted (austinpatel/liberogen_spatial_combination, austinpatel/liberogen_goal_chain, austinpatel/drawanything_sim)
sensorimotor._comment: The genesis king: one repo holding one converted public checkpoint per skill, one directory per skill.
